note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-5 English Wikipedia article on the Al-Fahd. The AF-40-8-2 column is recorded. Every value is grade claimed and the registry marks primary_held false. The article publishes the operating empty weight, the dimensions, the variable clearance, the engine rating, the road speed and the range. It carries an unreliable-source flag on the maker and no transmission type.
